definition_en: relating to the ear or to the sense of hearing
core_image: 世界经由耳朵进入 mind：听觉的一切
scene: 教室里，学生闭起眼睛，只凭录音辨出六种鸟鸣。The listening test measured the students' aural skills.
sceneCN: 这里 aural 指「听觉的」（第 1 个义项：与耳和听有关）；句意：这份听力测试考查学生的听觉技能。

derivatives.zh: 听说结合的（语言教学法术语，复合词）
音频的（同族词，出自 audire「听」）
听觉的（同族词，更常用于生理与神经层面）
耳廓；心耳（同形异源，出自 auricula「小耳」）

senses.title: Of the ear or hearing
senses.definition: relating to the ear or the sense of hearing
senses.example: The clinic tests aural acuity in newborns.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所为新生儿检测听觉敏锐度。
senses.why: The Latin root is auris, ear; everything in the word points at that organ.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根是 auris「耳」；全词一切都指向这个器官。

senses.title: Of received sound
senses.definition: of sounds as perceived by listening, as opposed to sight or touch
senses.definitionCN: 指通过聆听感知的声音，与视觉、触觉相对
senses.example: The film's aural landscape is as rich as its visuals.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影的听觉景观与视觉画面同样丰富。
senses.why: Critics needed a companion for visual, and aural answered.
senses.whyCN: 评论界需要一个与 visual 相对的词，aural 应运而生。

senses.title: In language teaching
senses.definition: of skills or tests involving listening comprehension
senses.definitionCN: 指涉及听力理解的技能或测验
senses.example: The exam has written, spoken, and aural components.
senses.exampleCN: 考试包括笔试、口试与听力三部分。
senses.why: Classrooms split language into channels, and aural named the listening channel.
senses.whyCN: 课堂把语言拆成不同通道，aural 命名了「听」的那条通道。

senses.title: In music training
senses.definition: of the ear-training side of musical skill, such as recognizing intervals by ear
senses.definitionCN: 指音乐技能中的练耳部分，如凭听辨音程
senses.example: Her aural training lets her write down melodies she only hears once.
senses.exampleCN: 练耳训练让她能把只听一遍的旋律记下来。
senses.why: Musicians sharpen the ear directly, so aural became their workshop word.
senses.whyCN: 音乐家直接锤炼耳朵，aural 便成了他们的行话。

senses.title: Of oral transmission
senses.definition: of knowledge or tradition passed on by listening rather than writing
senses.definitionCN: 指凭聆听而非文字传承的知识或传统
senses.example: The epic survived in an aural tradition for centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这部史诗在口耳相传的传统中存续了数百年。
senses.why: Before print, ears were the archive; aural tradition names that archive.
senses.whyCN: 印刷术之前，耳朵就是档案库；aural tradition 指的正是这座库。

senses.title: In psychology and perception
senses.definition: of perception through hearing, as one channel among several
senses.definitionCN: 指多通道感知中经由听觉的通道
senses.example: Subjects recalled aural cues better than visual ones.
senses.exampleCN: 受试者对听觉线索的记忆优于视觉线索。
senses.why: Psychology sorts stimuli by channel, and aural labels the ear's lane.
senses.whyCN: 心理学按通道给刺激分类，aural 标出耳朵那条道。

senses.title: Of recordings and media
senses.definition: of the sound dimension of recordings, film, or media
senses.definitionCN: 指录音、电影或媒介的声音维度
senses.example: The remaster improved the aural detail of the old concert tapes.
senses.exampleCN: 重新母带处理提升了老演唱会录音的听觉细节。
senses.why: Engineers speak of visual and aural quality, pairing the two senses again.
senses.whyCN: 工程师并称视觉与听觉质量，两种感官再次配对。

senses.title: Aural versus oral: the famous confusion
senses.definition: distinguished from oral, of the mouth, which sounds nearly identical
senses.definitionCN: 与读音几乎相同的 oral「口的」相区别
senses.example: An aural test uses your ears; an oral test uses your mouth.
senses.exampleCN: 听力测试用耳朵，口试用嘴巴。
senses.why: Two Latin roots, ear and mouth, landed on the same sound and left English a standing riddle.
senses.whyCN: 「耳」与「口」两个拉丁词根落在同一读音上，给英语留下了一道长久的谜题。

intro.en: Aural comes from Latin auris, ear, via the adjective auralis; English formed or borrowed it in the mid-nineteenth century, when science wanted a precise adjective for hearing.
intro.cn: aural 出自拉丁语 auris「耳」及其派生形容词 auralis；19 世纪中叶英语在科学需要精确的听觉形容词时形成或借入该词。

items.en: The root *h₂ewis- meant to perceive, and *h₂euc- gave the ear word found across many Indo-European languages.
items.cn: 词根 *h₂ewis- 意为「感知」，*h₂euc- 派生出众多印欧语言中的「耳」一词。

items.en: auris meant the ear; it also lies behind auricula, the little ear, and audio, I hear.
items.cn: 拉丁语 auris 意为「耳」；auricula「小耳」与 audio「我听」亦与之相关。

items.en: auralis meant of or belonging to the ear, a technical adjective in learned use.
items.cn: auralis 意为「属于耳的」，是学术用语中的技术性形容词。

items.en: English recorded aural in the mid-nineteenth century, first in physiological and psychological texts.
items.cn: 19 世纪中叶英语记录下 aural，最初见于生理学与心理学文献。

items.en: Music teaching and language testing adopted it as listening became an examinable skill.
items.cn: 随着「听」成为可考核的技能，音乐教学与语言测试也采用了这个词。

items.en: Today aural pairs with visual everywhere from film reviews to hearing clinics, still shadowed by its twin oral.
items.cn: 如今从影评到听力门诊，aural 与 visual 成对出现，却始终被孪生词 oral 误导着读音。

note.en: Group one collects the ear family and the notorious sound-alikes; group two collects neighboring perception words.
note.cn: 第一组收「耳」词族及 notorious 的同音词；第二组收相邻的感知词。

entries.definition: of the mouth, from Latin os, oris; nearly identical in sound, unrelated in root.
entries.definitionCN: 口的；出自拉丁语 os, oris，与 aural 读音几乎相同，词根无关。

entries.definition: of hearing, from audire, to hear; overlaps in meaning, different root from auris.
entries.definitionCN: 听觉的，出自 audire「听」；义有重叠，词根与 auris 不同。

entries.definition: the visible outer ear; literally the little ear, from auricula.
entries.definitionCN: 耳廓；本义「小耳」，出自 auricula。

entries.definition: of sound reproduction; from the hearing verb rather than the ear noun.
entries.definitionCN: 音频的；出自「听」的动词，而非「耳」的名词。

entries.definition: an atmosphere or glow around a person; from Greek aura, breeze; one letter apart.
entries.definitionCN: 气场；氛围，出自希腊语 aura「微风」；仅一字母之差。

entries.definition: of the sense of hearing, especially its physiology.
entries.definitionCN: 听觉的；尤指其生理层面。

entries.definition: of sound itself or its physical properties.
entries.definitionCN: 声学的；声音本身及其物理属性的。

entries.definition: the everyday participle for the act aural describes.
entries.definitionCN: 聆听的；aural 所指行为的日常说法。

entries.definition: of sight; the standard counterpart to aural.
entries.definitionCN: 视觉的；aural 的标准对应词。

entries.definition: of words, spoken or written; a broader channel term.
entries.definitionCN: 言语的；涵盖口头与书面的更宽通道。

normalIntro.en: aural starts like the Greek-latin ear-word auris: keep the ear in the first syllable.
normalIntro.cn: aural 开头即「耳」的古典词 auris：把耳朵记住在第一个音节里。

normal.en: aural = auris (ear) + al: an adjective pointing at the ear.
normal.cn: aural = auris（耳）+ al：指向耳朵的形容词。

normal.en: aural tests your ears; oral tests your mouth. Same sound, different doors.
normal.cn: aural 考耳朵，oral 考嘴巴。同音不同门。

normal.en: auricle, the little ear, is the same root you can see in the mirror.
normal.cn: auricle「耳廓」是同根词——你在镜子里就能看到的耳朵。

normal.en: Pair it consciously: visual and aural, sight and hearing.
normal.cn: 有意识地配对：visual 与 aural，视与听。

normal.en: In exams, aural comprehension means listening comprehension.
normal.cn: 考试里，aural comprehension 就是听力理解。

abstract.en: Picture the world arriving as sound alone: doors, rain, footsteps, voices.
abstract.cn: 想象世界只以声音抵达：门、雨、脚步、人声。

abstract.en: Aural is the ear's adjective, standing quietly beside loud visual.
abstract.cn: aural 是耳朵的形容词，安静地站在喧闹的 visual 旁边。

abstract.en: Close your eyes and read a room by ear: that is aural skill.
abstract.cn: 闭眼凭听辨读一个房间：这就是 aural skill。

examples.en: Strong aural memory helps musicians learn songs by ear.
examples.cn: 出色的听觉记忆帮助乐手凭听学会歌曲。

examples.en: The aural version of the guide is popular with commuters.
examples.cn: 语音版指南深受通勤者欢迎。

examples.en: The child's aural perception developed earlier than her reading.
examples.cn: 孩子的听觉感知比阅读能力发展得更早。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥柔」——奥数老师声音温柔，全靠耳朵听讲

root: 出自拉丁语 auris「耳」+ 形容词后缀 -alis（auralis「属于耳的」），19 世纪中叶进入英语作为听觉的技术性形容词；与 auricle 同根，与 audio、auditory（出自 audire「听」）义近而根不同；与 oral（出自 os「口」）同音异源，词源确凿。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses extend one ear-adjective from anatomy outward: received sound, classroom listening, music training, oral tradition, and the famous aural-oral mix-up.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把一个「耳」的形容词从解剖学向外延伸：所闻之声、课堂听力、音乐练耳、口耳相传，以及著名的 aural-oral 之辨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the world arriving through the ear alone.
core.cn: 核心意象：世界只经由耳朵抵达。

branches.en: THE ORGAN SIDE: the ear in anatomy, clinics, and perception studies.
branches.cn: 器官一面：解剖、门诊与感知研究中的耳朵。

branches.en: THE CLASSROOM SIDE: listening tests and musical ear-training.
branches.cn: 课堂一面：听力测验与音乐练耳。

branches.en: THE MEDIA SIDE: aural landscapes and sound quality.
branches.cn: 媒介一面：听觉景观与音质。

branches.en: THE ARCHIVE SIDE: traditions carried by listening alone.
branches.cn: 档案一面：单凭聆听传承的传统。

branches.en: THE PUZZLE SIDE: aural against oral, ear against mouth.
branches.cn: 谜题一面：aural 对 oral，耳对口。

intro.en: aural is auris plus -al, a plain adjective ending; the ear root stays visible in auricle and auricular.
intro.cn: aural 由 auris 加 -al 构成，是朴素的形容词词尾；「耳」的词根在 auricle、auricular 中清晰可见。

latinIntro.en: Latin auris, ear, anchors this branch: aural, auricle, auricular, while the audire branch holds audio and auditory.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 auris「耳」锚定这一支：aural、auricle、auricular；而 audire「听」一支则拥有 audio 与 auditory。

items.meaning: the outer ear; an atrium of the heart
of the ear; told in confidence
